title: Policy Decision (v2)
description: Decision object returned by policy evaluation. Matches the Tier-1 minimum decision response (docs/agentic-aiops-platform/policy-specification.md). v2 (SPEC-030) adds the require_approval outcome and activates the previously reserved approval_tier field; the optional approval object mirrors the winning rule's approval block so callers never re-read the bundle. conditions remains reserved for a future schema revision.

decision.description: Final outcome. deny is the default when no rule matches. require_approval means the action is allowed only through the tiered confirmation flow; approval_tier carries the winning rule's level.

matched_rule_ids.description: Identifiers of the rules that matched the request. Empty when denied by default.

subject.description: The principal subject the decision applies to.

approval_tier.description: Activated in v2 (SPEC-030): the winning require_approval rule's tier. Present only when decision is require_approval.

approval.description: Mirror of the winning rule's approval block so callers never re-read the bundle. Present only when decision is require_approval.

allow_self_approval.description: Optional override of the tier default; absent means the tier default applies (tier_1 allows, tier_2 forbids).
